_about: Rendered item art (W1-ICONART). Regenerate with tools/render_icons.py; models are procedural bpy builders in tools/blender/items/.
quality: procedural_v1 = low-poly bpy primitives, a placeholder tier; every item is to be replaced by higher-quality art. 'replace' marks the weakest first; 'missing' lists items.json ids with no render yet (they show the flat white symbol).

rig.name: studio_v1
rig.camera: orthographic, view dir (0.42,-1,0.62), fit to projected bounds, margin 0.085
rig.lights: key area 520W warm (-3,-4,5), fill area 170W cool (4,-2,1.5), rim area 700W (1,5,4), gradient world 0.45
rig.post: 4px dark outline at 512, 2x box downsample, zeroed border rows, deterministic PNG encode
